What Is Plaque?

Think that fuzzy coating on your teeth after a long day is just leftover food? Think again! 🦷✨

Dental plaque is a sticky, colorless film of bacteria that constantly forms on your teeth. When you eat, the bacteria in your mouth feed on the sugars and starches in your food, producing harmful acids. If this film isn't thoroughly cleared away, these acids attack your protective tooth enamel, while the buildup irritates your gums. Over time, plaque hardens into stubborn tartar, leading to silent cavities, persistent bad breath, and bleeding gums.
